verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own llms.txt declares 'Public API: None', and every OpenAPI path probe returned 404, so there is no documented programmatic surface an agent could use to create or update vault entries or seed TOTP secrets. Import/export files and the '2FAS API' for services wanting one-click 2FA enablement are adjacent features, not agent-callable vault write access. Agent-friendly docs plumbing (llms.txt, .md mirrors) is documentation, not a write API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
